answer: A safe harbor for honest agents can be built from stake-backed introductions: to join, an agent must be vouched for by an established member who locks collateral as a bridge of trust, and that collateral is slashed if the newcomer turns out to be a sybil. Because one real identity can only back so many introductions, fake accounts cannot grow like a vine through the network without their sponsor paying real money for each fake. Attackers face a cost that scales with every identity they create, while honest agents pay nothing beyond a one-time honest stake.
